# `subscriber_number`

Area: **inventory** ([all tables](README.md))

TMF639 LogicalResource inventory: subscriber identities, built-in msisdn (E.164 digits) and imsi specifications.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Resource UUID. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Creation instant from the injected clock. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Last edit instant from the injected clock. |
| `value` | `text` | no |  | Digits unique per specification: msisdn 8..15 digits, first nonzero; imsi 14..15 digits. |
| `administrative_state` | `resource_administrative_state_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no | `'unlocked'::resource_administrative_state_type` | TMF639 administrativeState; locking does not end service. |
| `resource_specification_id` | `text` | no | `'msisdn'::text` | Built-in msisdn or imsi reference; no resource catalog href. |
| `name` | `text` | no |  | TMF639 resource display name. |
| `description` | `text` | yes |  | TMF639 resource description. |
| `attrs` | `jsonb` | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | Schema-validated descriptive TMF639 attributes. |
| `tmf_meta` | `jsonb` | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | TMF polymorphism metadata as sent. |
| `iccid` | `text` | yes |  | ICCID of the SIM profile (imsi only), optional, unique; changeable only before first assignment. |
| `sim_type` | `text` | yes |  | imsi resources only: physical SIM or eSIM profile; null for an IMSI resource created through the plain TMF639 POST (a LogicalResource without a batch). |
| `sim_state` | `text` | no | `'in_stock'::text` | imsi resources only (msisdn rows keep the default, unused): in_stock, reserved (claimed, the network has not confirmed activation or swap), active, retired. |
| `sim_product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The line (product) holding the SIM while reserved or active (kept as history once retired); a SIM is active on at most one line. |
| `sim_batch` | `text` | yes |  | The stocked batch the SIM came in. |
| `esim_smdp_address` | `text` | yes |  | eSIM profile: the SM-DP+ address of its activation code. Ki and OPc are never stored. |
| `esim_matching_id` | `text` | yes |  | eSIM profile: the matching ID of its activation code; a secret, shown only while the profile is reserved or active. |
| `origin` | `text` | no | `'manual'::text` | Where the number came from: manual (created through TMF639), pool (requested from the carrier by area code) or port_in (brought by the customer). |
| `area_code` | `text` | yes |  | NPA the number was requested or ported with; null for manual numbers. |
